HOMEPAGE.PART1TITLE: Enjoy the best beauty services at home
HOMEPAGE.PART1TEXT: Our qualified professionals come to you to offer quality beauty treatments, tailored to your needs and desires. Experience a unique wellness moment, whether during your lunch break, after work in the evening, or during an afternoon with friends.
HOMEPAGE.PART2TITLE: Work when you want, earn flexible income
HOMEPAGE.PART2TEXT: Generate income according to your own schedule by accepting requests on the platform at your own pace. You can use your own equipment or choose to rent professional equipment via izyGlam.
HOMEPAGE.PART3TITLE: A reimagined beauty service for businesses
HOMEPAGE.PART3TEXT: Glam for Business is a platform dedicated to businesses of all sizes, designed to manage the beauty needs of your clients and employees. Offer personalized beauty treatments directly at the workplace, during corporate events, or for special occasions. Our qualified professionals come to provide services tailored to your needs.

CONFIDENTIAL.INTRO_BIS: When you use izyGlam, you trust us with your personal data. We are committed to honoring your trust by protecting your information. This privacy statement describes the personal data ('data') we collect, how we use and share it, and your choices regarding it. We advise you to read this document carefully.
CONFIDENTIAL.DECLARATION: This statement applies to users of the izyGlam platform, which connects individuals and businesses with independent beauty professionals, such as manicurists, pedicurists, makeup artists, and hairdressers. It covers all the services offered by izyGlam worldwide.
CONFIDENTIAL.PERSONNAL: Personal information (name, email address, phone number), account information (login details, passwords, beauty service preferences), payment information (credit card details, bank information, transaction history)
CONFIDENTIAL.CREATE_DATA: Data created during the use of our services
CONFIDENTIAL.HISTORY: Browsing history, cookies, IP address, browser type, operating system, time spent on the platform
CONFIDENTIAL.DETAILS: Details about beauty professionals contacted, services requested, appointment times, communications exchanged
CONFIDENTIAL.BEST_SERVICES: Provide and improve our services, personalize your experience, and process your orders.
CONFIDENTIAL.PARTICULIER: Facilitate the connection between individuals/businesses and independent beauty professionals.
CONFIDENTIAL.SEND: Send you information about our products, services, special offers, and new features.
CONFIDENTIAL.ASSURER: Ensure the security of our systems and prevent fraud.
CONFIDENTIAL.EFFECTUER: Conduct analyses to understand platform usage trends.
CONFIDENTIAL.PERSONNALISER: Personalize your experience based on your preferences and usage history.
CONFIDENTIAL.RGPD: Under GDPR, you have the right to
CONFIDENTIAL.PERSONNAL_DATA_ACCESS: Access your personal data and request a copy.
CONFIDENTIAL.ASK_CORRECTION: Request correction of incorrect or incomplete data.
CONFIDENTIAL.ASK_DELETE: Request the deletion of your data ('right to be forgotten').
CONFIDENTIAL.RESTREINDRE: Restrict or object to the processing of your data.
CONFIDENTIAL.ASK_PORTA: Request the portability of your data to another service.
CONFIDENTIAL.CONSENT: Withdraw your consent at any time when processing is based on consent.
CONFIDENTIAL.RECLAMATION: File a complaint with a competent supervisory authority if you believe your rights are not being respected.
CONFIDENTIAL.MANAGE_COOKIES_PREF: You can manage your cookie preferences via your browser settings or a cookie management tool available on our site. In the future, izyGlam may use other technologies to track users.
CONFIDENTIAL.WE_SHARE: We share your personal data only with trusted third parties, necessary for processing your orders and providing services such as
CONFIDENTIAL.FOURNISSEUR_SERV: Payment service providers for secure transaction processing.
CONFIDENTIAL.TRANSPORT: Carriers or couriers for product delivery, if applicable.
CONFIDENTIAL.MARKETING: Marketing and advertising service providers, only with your consent.
CONFIDENTIAL.HEALTHCARE: Independent beauty specialists with whom you have made appointments via the platform.
CONFIDENTIAL.CLOUD: Cloud and hosting service providers to ensure the availability and security of our platform.
CONFIDENTIAL.WE_SAVE: We retain your personal data only for as long as necessary to achieve the purposes for which it was collected, including to meet any legal, accounting, or reporting obligations. Data is typically retained for 3 to 6 months.
CONFIDENTIAL.TECHNICAL: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against loss, misuse, unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or destruction. These measures include data encryption in transit and at rest, strong authentication for access to internal systems, and continuous monitoring for potential threats and security vulnerabilities. We have not yet implemented data breach response protocols, but this is something we are considering for the future.
CONFIDENTIAL.PERSONNAL_DATA: The personal data we collect may be transferred and stored in countries outside the European Economic Area (EEA). When such transfers occur, we ensure that they are carried out in accordance with applicable regulations using mechanisms such as the standard contractual clauses approved by the European Commission.
CONFIDENTIAL.QUESTION: For any questions regarding our privacy policy or to exercise your rights, please contact us at: userprotection@izyglam.com.
CONFIDENTIAL.RESERVES: We reserve the right to modify this privacy policy at any time. In the event of significant changes, we will notify you by email. We encourage you to regularly review this page to stay informed of updates.
